Photos of actual-looking everyday products; no fake service guarantees, fake discounts, coins, countdowns, ratings or promotional badges. Product rails "Popular right now" and "Recently viewed"; recommendation grid "Picked for you", two columns at normal text size, square image, two-line product title, Shop name, prominent PHP price and Add to Cart action.
